name: Homarr control plane
summary: Add Homarr as a private dashboard and agent-facing control plane for selected self-hosted services.
acceptance: The selected control plane is API-ready on its private service route.
Administrator onboarding completes without exposing credentials.
Configuration storage has protected backup and restore guidance.

name: Full private home server
summary: Set up one bounded household stack for owned media, photos, files, music, audiobooks, and passwords, with Homarr as the recommended dashboard and home automation available only when selected.

roles.name: Movies and shows
roles.reason: Stream an owned movie and TV library through the supported media setup.
roles.purpose: Jellyfin gives your owned movies and shows a TV-style library and playback experience; it does not supply subscription content.

roles.name: Media requests
roles.reason: Use the supported media setup for approved search and request workflows.
roles.purpose: Seerr lets approved household users search for and request movies or shows from authorized sources.

roles.name: TV organization
roles.reason: Keep the supported media graph complete for television libraries.
roles.purpose: Sonarr organizes approved TV files and coordinates them with the downloader.

roles.name: Movie organization
roles.reason: Keep the supported media graph complete for movie libraries.
roles.purpose: Radarr organizes approved movie files and coordinates them with the downloader.

roles.name: Media source manager
roles.reason: Share only the explicitly selected authorized source with Sonarr and Radarr.
roles.purpose: Prowlarr shares an approved indexer configuration with Sonarr and Radarr; no source is selected automatically.

roles.name: Media downloader
roles.reason: Complete the supported media setup while preserving the owned-content boundary.
roles.purpose: qBittorrent downloads only files the user is authorized to acquire into the selected media paths.

roles.name: Photos and phone backup
roles.reason: Provide a focused private photo library and mobile backup.
roles.purpose: Immich backs up, organizes, searches, and shares photos from approved devices.

roles.name: Files and sharing
roles.reason: Use one service for Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox-style file needs.
roles.purpose: Nextcloud stores, synchronizes, and shares general files between approved people and devices.

roles.name: Music
roles.reason: Provide a focused private music library.
roles.purpose: Navidrome indexes and streams your owned music files to approved clients.

roles.name: Audiobooks
roles.reason: Provide audiobook-focused metadata, progress, and clients.
roles.purpose: Audiobookshelf organizes and streams your owned audiobooks and can also manage podcasts.

roles.name: Passwords
roles.reason: Provide a private password vault with explicit HTTPS and recovery requirements.
roles.purpose: Vaultwarden stores passwords for compatible Bitwarden apps after HTTPS, recovery, and backup are proven.

roles.name: Home automation
roles.reason: Add home automation only after compatible devices, voice hardware, and host access are confirmed.
roles.purpose: Home Assistant connects compatible household devices; voice also needs microphone and speaker hardware plus an Assist pipeline.

acceptance: The supported media stage passes its seven-service API, UI, Homarr, and MCP acceptance without choosing an indexer automatically.
Immich, Nextcloud, Navidrome, Audiobookshelf, and Vaultwarden each pass owner-specific readiness and private-access checks.
Every selected stateful service has app-consistent backup and isolated restore evidence.
Homarr contains one reviewed household board with working app links and only supported live integrations.
Optional home automation remains absent unless explicitly selected and its hardware dependencies are proven.

name: Personal media
summary: Request, organize, and play an authorized private movie and TV library.

roles.name: Playback
roles.reason: Plays your own movies and shows on approved devices.
roles.purpose: The media player streams your own movies and shows to approved devices.

roles.name: Requests
roles.reason: Lets approved users search for and request a movie or show.
roles.purpose: Seerr lets approved users search for and request a movie or show.

roles.name: TV automation
roles.reason: Keeps TV shows organized and sends approved downloads to the downloader.
roles.purpose: Sonarr organizes TV shows and passes approved items to the downloader.

roles.name: Movie automation
roles.reason: Keeps movies organized and sends approved downloads to the downloader.
roles.purpose: Radarr organizes movies and passes approved items to the downloader.

roles.name: Search sources
roles.reason: Manages approved search sources once and shares them with Sonarr and Radarr.
roles.purpose: Prowlarr manages approved search sources for Sonarr and Radarr in one place.

roles.name: Downloader
roles.reason: Downloads approved files into the shared download folder.
roles.purpose: The downloader saves approved files into the shared download folder.

roles.name: Subtitles
roles.reason: Finds and organizes subtitles when you choose to enable it.
roles.purpose: Bazarr finds and organizes subtitles for the selected movies and shows.

roles.name: Downloader VPN
roles.reason: Keeps only downloader traffic behind a VPN and must stop leaks if the tunnel fails.
roles.purpose: Gluetun sends only downloader traffic through a VPN and blocks leaks when it fails.

acceptance: Every selected application is API-ready on service-name DNS.
Seerr reaches playback plus the selected Arr services.
Shared paths support the selected import and hardlink policy.

name: Owned movie and TV library
summary: Stream movies and shows you already own through Jellyfin, with Homarr as the recommended dashboard and no implied content subscription.

roles.name: Owned-library playback
roles.reason: Jellyfin indexes and streams the authorized media files supplied by the owner.
roles.purpose: Jellyfin streams your existing movie and TV files; it does not include or sell a catalog of content.

acceptance: Jellyfin scans a bounded owned-media fixture and plays it from an approved client.
Homarr opens Jellyfin and its dedicated integration returns expected library data.
The plan identifies media storage and backup responsibilities without claiming bundled content.

name: Photos and mobile backup
summary: Keep original photos private while providing mobile backup, search, and recovery.

roles.name: Photo library
roles.reason: Own the photo index, original files, and client experience.
roles.purpose: The photo library backs up, organizes, searches, and shares photos from your devices.

acceptance: A test upload is visible from an approved client.
Originals and application database have separate protected backup coverage.
A restore drill proves metadata and one original can be recovered.

name: Photos and cloud files
aliases: replace google photos and google drive
summary: Replace photo backup with Immich and general cloud files with one Nextcloud service.

roles.name: Photo library
roles.reason: Use a photo-focused mobile backup and library experience.
roles.purpose: Immich backs up, organizes, searches, and shares photos from approved devices.

roles.name: Cloud files
roles.reason: Use one general file service for Drive-style sync and sharing.
roles.purpose: Nextcloud stores, synchronizes, and shares general files between approved people and devices.

acceptance: A mobile photo upload appears in Immich.
A representative general file round-trips through Nextcloud.
Immich and Nextcloud data plus databases have separately tested restore coverage.

name: Documents, PDF, and OCR
summary: Ingest, OCR, search, transform, and recover private documents.

roles.name: Document archive
roles.reason: Own durable ingest, metadata, OCR, search, and export.
roles.purpose: The document archive reads scans, makes their text searchable, and keeps the originals.

roles.name: PDF toolbox
roles.reason: Add private PDF transformations without confusing them with archival storage.
roles.purpose: Stirling PDF edits, converts, joins, and splits PDFs in a private web tool.

acceptance: A test document is ingested, OCR text is searchable, and the original exports.
Database, media, and export paths have an app-consistent restore procedure.

name: Files and synchronization
summary: Replace Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, and Dropbox with one file service and explicit recovery.

roles.name: File service
roles.reason: Match collaborative cloud storage or device synchronization to the real goal.
roles.purpose: The file service stores or synchronizes files between the people and devices you choose.

acceptance: A representative file round-trips through the selected clients.
Deletion propagation and conflict policy are documented.
A separate backup recovers data independently from synchronization.

name: Passwords
summary: Host a recovery-sensitive password vault behind private, authenticated TLS.

roles.name: Password vault
roles.reason: Provide encrypted client access with an explicit recovery model.
roles.purpose: The vault keeps passwords encrypted and makes them available to approved apps and browsers.

acceptance: TLS, login, lockout, and recovery are tested from an approved client.
An encrypted export and full restore drill succeed without exposing secret values.

name: Home automation
summary: Run a private automation hub with deliberate LAN discovery, voice hardware, and device privileges.

roles.name: Automation hub
roles.reason: Own device state, automations, client access, and optional voice pipelines.
roles.purpose: Home Assistant connects smart-home devices and can coordinate voice assistants when compatible microphone, speaker, wake-word, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech components are supplied.

roles.name: Automation flows
roles.reason: Add visual flows only when their control scope is understood.
roles.purpose: Node-RED lets you build automations by connecting steps in a visual editor.

roles.name: Camera recorder
roles.reason: Add local recording and detection only with hardware, licensing, and retention planning.
roles.purpose: The selected camera platform connects approved cameras and can record or process their streams.

acceptance: Required LAN devices remain discoverable after restart.
A test automation executes without granting unrelated host control.
Configuration and device recovery steps are verified.

name: Audiobooks and music
summary: Stream an owned audiobook and music library through focused private services.

roles.name: Audiobooks
roles.reason: Use audiobook-focused metadata, progress, and client support.
roles.purpose: Audiobookshelf organizes and streams your owned audiobooks and can also manage podcasts.

roles.name: Music
roles.reason: Use a lightweight music library with broad Subsonic-compatible client support.
roles.purpose: Navidrome indexes and streams your owned music files to approved clients.

acceptance: An owned audiobook preserves playback progress from an approved client.
An owned music fixture is indexed and streams from an approved client.
Homarr opens both services and each dedicated integration returns expected data.

name: Personal finance
summary: Choose a private budget or finance tracker with explicit import, export, and recovery boundaries.

roles.name: Finance tracker
roles.reason: Choose the workflow that matches envelope budgeting or broader transaction and account tracking.
roles.purpose: The finance tracker stores budgets, accounts, and transactions for approved users.

acceptance: A redacted sample transaction imports and exports without loss.
Authentication and private access are verified from an approved client.
A database and uploads restore proves the finance data is recoverable.

name: Private notes and knowledge
summary: Choose a local-first knowledge tool and make its sync and backup boundary explicit.

roles.name: Notes workspace
roles.reason: Anytype and Obsidian have different client, synchronization, and server ownership models.
roles.purpose: The selected notes workspace stores linked personal notes locally and uses only the synchronization path you approve.

acceptance: A representative note remains available offline and synchronizes only through the selected path.
Export and restore preserve the representative note and its attachment.
The plan distinguishes a local client workspace from a self-hosted synchronization service.

name: Remote access
summary: Expose selected services through a private overlay or separately approved public edge.

roles.name: Private device network
roles.reason: Prefer identity-aware private access for trusted devices.
roles.purpose: The private network lets trusted devices reach selected services without making them public.

roles.name: Public tunnel
roles.reason: Add public reachability only when the user needs it and accepts the provider or VPS boundary.
roles.purpose: A tunnel carries approved public traffic to one service without opening a direct inbound port.

roles.name: Web traffic router
roles.reason: Reuse one existing DNS/TLS/port owner or select one explicitly.
roles.purpose: The web traffic router gives selected services HTTPS addresses and sends each request to the right app.

acceptance: The intended client resolves and reaches only the selected service.
TLS and identity policy are valid for public routes.
Direct management ports remain private.

name: Backups and restore
summary: Capture app-consistent state into an off-host repository and prove recovery.

roles.name: Backup tool
roles.reason: Create encrypted, versioned backups with explicit retention.
roles.purpose: The backup tool keeps encrypted versions of important files in a separate location.

roles.name: Virtual-machine backup
roles.reason: Add VM and container coverage when Proxmox owns the host boundary.
roles.purpose: Proxmox Backup Server protects virtual machines and system containers managed by Proxmox.

acceptance: Application-native capture succeeds before repository upload.
At least one copy is in a separate failure domain.
A fresh bounded restore proves application usability.

name: Monitoring and observability
summary: Cover process, application, and edge health with bounded retention and alerts.

roles.name: Uptime checks
roles.reason: Prove service and edge reachability from a defined failure domain.
roles.purpose: The uptime checker regularly opens each service and alerts you when it cannot be reached.

roles.name: Server health
roles.reason: Track host and container resource pressure.
roles.purpose: The server monitor shows CPU, memory, disk, and container usage.

roles.name: Measurements
roles.reason: Add durable metrics only when query and retention needs justify it.
roles.purpose: The metrics service stores numeric health and performance measurements over time.

roles.name: Monitoring dashboards
roles.reason: Visualize selected data sources without duplicating a navigation dashboard.
roles.purpose: Grafana turns monitoring measurements into charts and dashboards.

roles.name: Service logs
roles.reason: Centralize logs only with redaction and retention policy.
roles.purpose: The log service collects searchable app messages for troubleshooting.

acceptance: Container, application, and edge checks each have evidence.
Alerts reach a tested destination.
Retention and secret redaction are configured before log ingestion.

name: DNS and network filtering
summary: Own LAN DNS deliberately with filtering, fallback, and port-conflict checks.

roles.name: Network name service
roles.reason: Provide one explicit owner for client DNS and optional filtering.
roles.purpose: The DNS service finds internet addresses for your devices and can block selected domains.

roles.name: Independent DNS lookup
roles.reason: Add recursion only when operating it safely is an explicit goal.
roles.purpose: Unbound can answer DNS requests by looking them up directly instead of using a public resolver.

acceptance: Port ownership and fallback resolver behavior are proven.
A LAN client resolves allowed names and filtering policy behaves as selected.
Management remains limited to trusted networks.

name: Local AI
summary: Serve selected local models through a private chat interface with hardware-aware storage.

roles.name: AI model runner
roles.reason: Own model execution and model storage on the selected host.
roles.purpose: Ollama downloads supported AI models and runs them on your own hardware.

roles.name: Private AI chat
roles.reason: Provide authenticated client access without publishing the model API directly.
roles.purpose: Open WebUI gives approved users a private web chat for the local AI models.

roles.name: Server monitoring
roles.reason: Observe compute and storage pressure when requested.
roles.purpose: The monitor shows whether AI workloads are running out of processor, memory, or disk capacity.

acceptance: The selected model loads within measured memory and storage limits.
The chat UI reaches the model over a private service route.
The model API and conversation history are not publicly exposed.

name: Downloader privacy
summary: Route only an approved downloader through a VPN namespace and prove fail-closed egress.

roles.name: Downloader
roles.reason: Keep the privacy boundary limited to the downloader process.
roles.purpose: qBittorrent downloads approved files while remaining isolated from the other services.

roles.name: Downloader VPN
roles.reason: Own the tunnel namespace, firewall, DNS, and recovery path.
roles.purpose: Gluetun sends only downloader traffic through a VPN and blocks leaks when the tunnel fails.

acceptance: Downloader public IP and DNS use the selected VPN while healthy.
Breaking the tunnel makes downloader egress fail instead of using the host route.
Restoring the tunnel restores the expected VPN egress.
Control-plane and management traffic remain outside the downloader namespace.

name: Hosting platform
summary: Prepare a Mac, Ubuntu host, VPS, NAS, or hypervisor for bounded self-hosted projects.

roles.name: App container runner
roles.reason: Provide isolated Compose projects after the target host is inspected.
roles.purpose: Docker runs each selected app in a clearly owned and isolated project.

roles.name: Server platform
roles.reason: Select an appliance or hypervisor only when it already owns or should own the machine.
roles.purpose: The server platform manages storage, virtual machines, or apps for the whole machine.

roles.name: Remote web access
roles.reason: Assign one DNS, TLS, and port owner when remote services require it.
roles.purpose: The web access service gives approved apps HTTPS addresses and sends traffic to the right place.

roles.name: Backup tool
roles.reason: Protect configuration and application state before workloads accumulate.
roles.purpose: The backup tool keeps encrypted copies of configuration and app data away from the live system.

acceptance: Operating system, architecture, runtime, disks, networks, ports, and existing services are inventoried.
Project paths and ownership are reviewable before directory creation.
Ingress has one owner and direct management ports remain private.
A configuration backup and restore path exists before application deployment.
